location.story: The Turtle Who Couldn't Stop Talking

approved_translation: Know when to remain silent; talking at the wrong time brings disaster.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: A turtle lived in a pond at the foot of a hill. Two young wild Geese, looking for food, saw the Turtle, and talked with him. As the two Geese flew on, they heard the people say, when they came to see the poor Turtle, "That fellow could not keep his mouth shut. He had to talk, and so lost his life."
